clues.text: Coming before the LORD among the sons of God, he asked the LORD whether Job feared God for nothing.
When Peter rebuked Jesus for foretelling His death, Jesus called Peter a stumbling block and addressed him by this name.
He rose up against Israel and stirred King David to take a census of the people.
For forty days in the wilderness he tempted Jesus, who was there among the wild animals.
Peter asked Ananias why he had let this one fill his heart to lie to the Holy Spirit about the land money.
As the chief priests looked for a way to kill Jesus before Passover, he entered Judas Iscariot.
When the seventy-two returned rejoicing over the demons, Jesus said He saw him fall like lightning from heaven.
